rationale: Counts how many two-digit numbers can be formed from given digits under a no-leading-zero rule; no existing slug covers this counting/constraint task.
Requires selecting which set of jigsaw-like pieces tiles a rectangle with no gaps/overlaps; no existing slug covers tiling/dissection puzzles.
Finds a symbol at a given row/column address in a 4x4 grid by matching an example rule; distinct from table-lookup-combine which sums/subtracts two read values.
Solves star from 3*star=12 then substitutes into diamond+star=12; a two-step symbolic substitution not tied to weight/total-and-sugar framing of weight-balance-word.
Identifies which of four rotatable (not flippable) puzzle pieces occupies a marked spot in an assembled figure; no existing slug covers piece-to-figure rotation matching.
